About.title: About me
About.p1: Senior AI and Full-Stack engineer residing in South Korea — from Uzbekistan, living and working in Korea since 2023; fluent in Korean, English, and Russian.
About.p2: Engineered core architecture for Blue Networks' E-Chae-Um EV Charging Station Management System (CSMS) using Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, and sharded databases — implementing OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 protocol, real-time WebSocket telemetry pipelines, bulk OTA firmware distribution, and national KECO (Korea Environment Corp) inter-operator roaming data (로밍 데이터) synchronization & Smartro PG settlement reconciliation.
About.p3: Developed the AI-powered EV Charging Power Demand Forecasting & Contract Power Optimization Platform: utilizing an 8-model ensemble including PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and Extreme Value Theory (EVT - GEV/GPD) to forecast peak power loads with P50/P90 probabilistic quantiles, drastically mitigating KEPCO peak surcharge penalties and energy costs.
About.p4: Integrates premier LLM foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), TypeScript ecosystem (Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js) streaming AI assistants, voice-to-text (STT/TTS), and containerized deployments across Docker, NGINX, Linux, AWS, and GCP.
